intro: Your leave balance, the applications you have sent, and any comp-off you have earned. Days only leave your balance once an application is approved.

balance.heading: Balance
balance.emptyDescription: Balances appear once your HR team has a leave policy running for your employment type. You can still apply — the balance is checked when it's approved.

applications.heading: My applications
applications.emptyTitle: You haven't applied for any leave
applications.emptyDescription: Everything you apply for shows up here with its status, and stays until it is approved, rejected or withdrawn.

compOff.heading: My comp-off
compOff.intro: Days you worked when you did not have to. Once approved they are added to your comp-off balance and expire on the date shown, whether or not you use them.
compOff.emptyDescription: If you work a holiday or a weekly off, your HR team records it here and it becomes leave you can take later.

footerNote: Withdrawing an approved leave puts the days back in your balance and clears the on-leave days from your attendance. If payroll has already closed that month, it cannot be withdrawn and you will be told so.

cancelDialog.title: Withdraw this leave?
cancelDialog.description: Your {{leaveType}} from {{date}} will be withdrawn. If it was already approved, the days go back into your balance.
